goal: Adopt part A of the nvk/llm-wiki benchmark: credibility and aliases frontmatter fields with lint enforcement and a 27-page sources migration, three explicit wiki-query depths, a root ingest backlog, the benchmark report under docs/, and CLAUDE.md routing cleanup after the my-skills plugin removal.

tasks.title: Add credibility and aliases rules to wiki-content.md
tasks.acceptance: Section 1 defines: (a) credibility as a REQUIRED frontmatter key on wiki/sources/* pages with enum high|medium|low and a judgment rubric — official documentation and primary sources = high; conference talks, vendor blogs, well-known practitioners = medium; personal videos with known caption-error risk or unverifiable attribution = low; (b) aliases as an OPTIONAL frontmatter key on concepts/entities pages, a YAML list of alternate names (typically the English original term for a Korean title), noting Quartz reads it natively for search. Existing rules are not contradicted; the source-citation and template sections reference the new keys where they list frontmatter.

tasks.title: Enforce credibility and aliases in lint_wiki.py
tasks.acceptance: The frontmatter check fails (exit 1) when a wiki/sources/* page is missing credibility or has a value outside high|medium|low, and when any page has an aliases key whose value is not a YAML list of strings. Non-sources pages without credibility pass. The script stays stdlib-only and its existing checks are unchanged (same violations reported on the pre-change tree except the new ones).

tasks.title: Update source-page template and wiki-ingest skill for credibility
tasks.acceptance: templates/source-page.md includes credibility in its frontmatter block, and wiki-ingest SKILL.md instructs the agent to judge credibility per the rubric in docs/rules/wiki-content.md during ingest (one added step or line, no restructuring of the existing procedure).

tasks.title: Migrate the 27 existing source pages with credibility values
tasks.acceptance: Every page under wiki/sources/ carries a credibility value assigned per the rubric (YouTube playlist talks default to medium, pages with recorded caption errors or unverified attribution to low, official-documentation sources such as the Terraform and IBM pages to high). Body text and updated fields are untouched (frontmatter-only change; the updated-bump rule in wiki-content.md section 4.3 explicitly does not fire for metadata-only edits — confirm the rule allows this or record the exception there). python3 scripts/lint_wiki.py exits 0.

tasks.title: Document three query depths in wiki-query skill
tasks.acceptance: SKILL.md defines quick (indexes only), standard (relevant pages + grep, the default), and deep (all pages plus raw/ cross-check) query depths, with user phrasing cues (e.g. 가볍게/깊게) mapped to tiers. Existing procedure text is adjusted, not duplicated.

tasks.title: Create root backlog.md and wire it into skills
tasks.acceptance: Root backlog.md exists in Korean with a single table (candidate | type | status | note) and a header stating it is never citable as factual evidence in wiki pages. CLAUDE.md section 1 tree gains one line for it (unpublished — content root is wiki/ only, like log.md). wiki-ingest and wiki-query SKILL.md each gain one line: sources mentioned but not ingested now go to backlog.md.

tasks.title: Write the nvk benchmark report under docs/
tasks.acceptance: docs/benchmarking-nvk-llm-wiki.md (English) records the 2026-07-19 comparison: what nvk/llm-wiki is, the adopted items (credibility, aliases, query depths, backlog, volatility+refresh, retract mode, lint fixtures) each with a one-line rationale, and the rejected items (dual-linking, hub/multi-wiki, full inventory/dataset layers, librarian numeric scoring, lessons-learned op, multi-runtime packaging, token benchmarks, session hooks) each with a one-line reason. docs/index.md lists the new document and the phase-6/phase-7 folders.

tasks.title: Clean dead my-skills routing from CLAUDE.md
tasks.acceptance: CLAUDE.md no longer routes code mode to the uninstalled my-skills plugin skills (orchestrate, create-prd-json): section 3 describes code-mode work as executed directly from docs/tasks/ plans/PRDs, and section 1's tree/comment lines match. The .claude/orchestrate.md adapter reference is removed or marked dormant. No other routing (content-mode skills) changes.

tasks.title: Phase gate: full verification, log, catalog
tasks.acceptance: python3 scripts/lint_wiki.py exits 0; npx quartz build succeeds in site/ and site-test/ and python3 scripts/verify_site.py passes for both; one Korean docs-prefixed close-out line appended to log.md; docs/index.md phase table row updated with completion status.
